q: The symmetry of information in Kolmogorov complexity states:
opts: K(x) = K(y) for all x, y of the same length
K(x, y) = K(x) + K(y|x) + O(log(|x|+|y|)) = K(y) + K(x|y) + O(log)
exp: Symmetry of information: K(x,y) = K(x) + K(y|x) + O(log n) = K(y) + K(x|y) + O(log n). This is an analogue of the chain rule for entropy, but with a logarithmic error term inherent to the theory.
